description:
Complete the DataFrame implementation for ALL 136 Read Primitives queries.

Current state: 102 queries implemented, 34 remaining
Target: 133 queries with implementations (only 3 correlated-subquery queries are truly SQL-only)

This is a CORRECTION to the previous incomplete implementation that incorrectly
marked 49 queries as "skipped" or "expression-family-only" when they should have
been implemented.

KEY INSIGHT: Spark DataFrames are DECLARATIVE, not imperative. They build a logical
plan that goes through Catalyst optimizer - the same optimizations apply as SQL.
Therefore, 10 of the 13 "optimizer" queries CAN be tested via DataFrames by writing
them in "naive" form and letting Catalyst optimize.
